description: Short interest history for a Nasdaq-listed stock from Nasdaq.com (FINRA twice-monthly settlement data): settlement date, shares sold short, average daily share volume and days to cover, newest first (about one year of reports), plus the change versus the previous report. Only Nasdaq-listed symbols are supported by the source. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: finance_nasdaq_short_interest
title: Finance Nasdaq Short Interest
